text:
emily: FYI payment hold on BlueWave Analytics invoice INV-2026-0589. System flagged PO mismatch and a bank account change in the same submission.

liam: Can you paste the PO shown on the PDF? Ill try to auto-match.

emily: Invoice shows PO=BW-2024-9001. Our vendor master has BW-2026-1100 as the active PO after the Q1 vendor consolidation.

rachel: Sorry about the confusion  vendor merged two legal entities last week. AP accidentally used the legacy PO on the reissued invoice. Correct PO should be BW-2026-1100. Weve also uploaded new bank details because the payments entity changed.

```
Legacy acct: BW-L-777
New acct: BW-P-222 (effective 2026-03-22)
```

noah: Heads up  any bank detail change triggers KYC/KBA checks per policy. Approvals-bot will block until vendor verification is uploaded. Also PO mismatch prevents automatic routing to procurement.

approvals-bot: Hold placed: reason=[PO_MISMATCH, BANK_UPDATE]; next_steps=[attach_correct_po_doc, vendor_kba_doc, finance_override_if_urgent]

liam: Two paths: wait for procurement to confirm PO mapping (theyre in a backlog) OR Finance can perform a 2-person manual signoff to release payment this run. Which do we prefer?

emily: This invoice is for consumed inference credits (monthly run). Vendor emailed that they will assess 1.5% late fee after 7 days. Procurement is out until Friday. We should aim for manual finance signoff.

rachel: Uploading signed PO amendment and bank verification now. Zot: link https://files.bluewave.example/INV-2026-0589-merge.pdf

noah: Please ensure the amendment explicitly references both PO numbers and the vendor EIN. AML team wants the EIN included.

rachel: Amendment includes EIN and both PO numbers. Also added AP contact name and confirmation of account ownership.

liam: Ok if Emily posts a short audit note in the thread confirming GL code and cost center, I can request treasury to include in the next ACH batch. Need 2 approvals though  whos second approver? Noah can do platform confirm.

emily: GL=6203-ml-inference, cost_center=ml-platform-prod. Confirming both. Note: payment release is contingent on procurement retrospectively updating the PO mapping in the system.

noah: Confirming platform usage and GL. Ill also create a procurement ticket for the PO record update and CC Finance.

approvals-bot: Document uploaded. Pending actions updated: [procurement_update_ticket, treasury_manual_override_request].

liam: Submitted manual override to Treasury with reference: "BlueWave merged vendor; temporary finance signoff per thread; docs attached." Treasury ETA=36-48h. I flagged as high priority due to late fee risk.

emily: Thanks. Heads up to procurement: please reconcile BW-2024-9001 -> BW-2026-1100 in the PO master when youre back; this is recurring risk.

rachel: Appreciate the quick help. Vendor requests confirmation once payment initiated.

liam: Will post when treasury includes it in the batch or if they reject. If rejected, escalate to Finance Lead for emergency approval.

emily: Closing note: amendment + KBA attached, GL set, manual override requested, approvals-bot hold remains until procurement updates or treasury clears payment.

rachel: Thank you all :pray:
_meta: Slack thread export: vendor merged accounts caused PO mismatch + bank update; thread contains root + replies in chronological order
